arguments.text: PLAN (min 1): 10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Start hot (shaft 267 W vs CP 170, pod reserve 68 pct at 1 min). Aim: settle near even shaft power at the sustainable value (~175 W shaft), keep pod reserve for the last 1-1.5 km, finish cue ~1200 m out. Trust pod reserve over boat reserve (boat numbers blame current/drag on paddler). Watches: low reserve, sudden drag (push_local drop = possible weed on rudder), effort sag.

arguments.message: push_local dropped: extra drag (weed on rudder?) or adverse current
pod reserve low with far to go
shaft power well below sustainable for a minute

arguments.text: Good start. Settle now into your long race rhythm.

text: Cued ease to settle after a hot start (pod reserve 68 pct at 1 min); set watches for drag jump, low reserve, effort sag.
no cue: settled to 181 W shaft, only ~8 W over sustainable; watching reserve trend.

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Long way to go, find a pace you can hold.

Min 7 (1380 m): shaft ~178 W vs sustainable 172, pod reserve 28 pct falling ~3 pct/min. Paddler says 9/10, really hurting: supports CP being about right or high. Cued ease (no pace target; current flips each leg, about +-0.13 m/s). Check next wake: shaft should be <=172 W and reserve flat.
Ease a touch. Long way to go, find a holdable pace.

text: Cued ease: shaft 6-8 W over sustainable, pod reserve 28 pct and falling, paddler 9/10 at min 7.
no cue: ease cue given 30 s ago is still taking effect (cue gate also closed); speed fade only -1.3 pct, so let it work; effort-sag watch covers a collapse.

arguments.message: pod reserve below 12 pct with far to go

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > sustainable_shaft_power_w + 8 and elapsed_s > 600 and remaining_m > 1500
arguments.message: shaft power 8 W over sustainable for 90 s

arguments.text: Min 8.2: ease worked, shaft 173 W = sustainable 172, pod reserve 25 pct. Moved reserve_low watch to 12 pct; added over_sustainable watch (+8 W for 90 s). Paddler said at 7.7: cooked, cannot hold this (said, not proven; fade only -1.5 to -3 pct).

text: no cue: ease took effect, shaft power now at the sustainable 172 W; retuned reserve watch to 12 pct and added an over-sustainable watch.
no cue: shaft 167 W, a few W under sustainable, reserve rebuilding slowly to 28 pct after a hurting spell; fine to bank it for later.

arguments.text: Good rhythm. Back off just slightly, stay smooth and long.

Min 14.2 (2720 m): paddler drifted back up to 177 W shaft (pod reserve 23 pct, would empty in ~1.9 km). Cued ease again. Pattern: ease drops them ~12 W for a few min, then they creep back up; average near sustainable. Boat reserve reads 0 but speed fade only -0.4 pct: boat model / boat CP likely off; trust pod. Do not change CP yet.

text: Cued ease: shaft crept back to 177 W, pod reserve would empty in about 1.9 km at that effort.

arguments.text: You are right on pace and holding it. Steady, you have this.

Min 17 (3260 m): paddler says it hurts, doubts holding it. Data: shaft 171 W = sustainable, pod reserve steady 23-24 pct, fade -1.5 pct. Cued reassure. Boat reserve 0 since ~min 15 while boat power ~122 W > boat CP 115 with no fade: boat CP probably ~120+. cp_implied_w not yet available.

text: Cued reassure: paddler doubts they can hold, but shaft power is on the sustainable value and the pod reserve is steady.

arguments.text: Boat is running well. Lift a touch, keep it long.

Min 20 (3810 m, leg 4 upstream): push_local went from -0.15 to 0.0 in the last 2 min while push_along still says -0.14 (lags) -> adverse current eased locally (tide turning or slack water). speed_water and boat power (139 W) are inflated by the lag; ignore them. Shaft dropped to 163-166 W, under sustainable 173; pod reserve up to 27 pct. Cued a gentle push. Watch next downstream leg: help may be smaller than +0.15.

text: Cued a gentle push: shaft power had slipped 7 W under sustainable with the pod reserve rebuilding; noted the local current easing.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 9000 m.

arguments.text: Course shortened one leg. Finish is 4.9 km from here.

Min 21.7 (4114 m): RADIO course shortened, finish at 9000 m. Set race distance 9000 and told paddler 4.9 km to go. Plan: finish sprint cue at about 1200 m to go, i.e. near 7800 m. Current: push_local now ~0 on the north leg too (was +0.18) -> tide has slackened; push_along fit lags. Next cue: nudge shaft power up to the new sustainable value.

text: Set race distance to 9000 m after the radio message and told the paddler 4.9 km to go; sustainable shaft power barely moves (173 W) and they are at 175 W, so no pace change.

arguments.text: Min 24.7 (4676 m): shaft 175 W vs sustainable 173, pod reserve 19 pct falling ~2 pct/min (would empty ~2.6 km on, then CP = only 5 W less: acceptable). Fade -4.8 pct is an artifact: push_along fit still +0.08 but push_local ~ -0.03, so speed_water is understated; GPS 3.12 m/s at 175 W matches earlier. 20 min held near 172 W with no real fade -> pod CP 170 is about right. No cue.

text: no cue: shaft power only 2-3 W over sustainable; the apparent speed fade is the lagging current estimate, not the paddler.

arguments.text: Tide is with you now. Keep the pressure on, stay long.

Min 27.7 (5240 m, leg 6 south): TIDE TURNED. South legs now helped (push_local +0.16, was -0.13); north legs (7 and the last, 9) will now be against it. Paddler eased ~13-17 W right after the turn (shaft 156 W vs sustainable 173), a step change, not a sensor drift (GPS up to 3.19). Cued push. Plan: put the reserve into the upstream north legs; finish sprint on leg 9 from ~1200 m out (about 7800 m). Avoid pulling long series: costly.

text: Cued push: paddler eased 13-17 W after the turn once the turned tide sped the boat up; shaft power 156 W against a sustainable 173 W.

arguments.text: You have reserve left. Lift the pressure back up now.

Min 29.5 (5570 m): effort_sag alert, shaft 145 W vs sustainable 175, pod reserve back up to 28 pct. First push cue (27.8) was not followed. Paddler says 7/10 (was 9/10 at min 7), really hurting: lower effort rating supports a real ease, not pod drift. Cued push again. If shaft stays low after the turn into the tide (north leg 7) while GPS speed holds near 3.1, suspect pod drift instead (check push_local on the north leg: real current should make it negative).

text: Cued push again: shaft power 30 W under sustainable with the pod reserve refilling; paddler rates effort 7/10, so the drop looks like a real ease.

arguments.message: speed through water below 2.97 m/s for 45 s: real slowdown (fatigue, drag) - pod power is unreliable

arguments.text: Min 32.5 (6140 m): POD DRIFT. Since ~min 27 shaft reads 145-147 W yet GPS 3.19 south AND 3.09 north (push_local + on BOTH legs: +0.17, +0.05). A real 17 pct power drop would cut speed ~6 pct; it did not, fade +0.4 pct. So the pod reads ~15 pct low; its reserve (43 pct) and sustainable shaft power are false. Real effort ~172-175 W, true pod reserve probably ~10-15 pct. Ignore pod numbers; pace by speed through water (~3.12-3.15 m/s). Removed pod watches, added speed_drop watch. Earlier push cues were (rightly) not followed.

FINISH PLAN: legs 8 (south, 7000-8000 m) and 9 (north, 8000-9000 = finish). Cue finish at the start of leg 9 (~8000 m, 1000 m to go); small true reserve so not earlier. Before that only hold or reassure. Current now small (+-0.05).

arguments.message: 1000 m to go: give the finish cue now

text: no cue: the pod has drifted about 15 pct low (boat speed unchanged on both legs), so the paddler is really near sustainable; switched to speed-based watches and set a 1000 m-to-go finish alert.

arguments.text: Holding well. Stay long and smooth, 2.3 km to go.

arguments.message: 750 m to go: give the finish cue now

arguments.text: Min 35.5 (6700 m): paddler 10/10 really hurting; speed through water 3.07 (down ~1.5 pct vs leg 5, both north legs), boat power 115 = boat CP: at about CP, true reserve small. Cued hold. Moved finish cue later, to ~8250 m (750 m to go) to avoid a blow-up; finish_point watch updated.

text: Cued hold: paddler at 10/10 and at about critical power by boat speed; finish cue moved to 750 m to go.
no cue: steady at about critical power by boat speed (3.06 m/s), current small; waiting for the 750 m-to-go finish alert.
no cue: holding 3.08 m/s at about critical power with 1.2 km left; finish cue planned at 750 m to go by watch.

arguments.text: Last 750 metres. Go now, empty the tank to the line.
Min 43.9 (8244 m): finish cue given at 756 m to go (last leg, north). If speed collapses below ~2.9 m/s in the next 2-3 min, a reassure/hold may help; otherwise stay quiet. No cues in the last 100 m.

text: Cued finish at 750 m to go: the last leg, with the small reserve spent over the final few minutes.

arguments.text: 200 metres. Stay with it, long strokes to the line.

text: Cued hold at 214 m to go: the finish sprint blew the paddler up (speed 3.18 down to 2.77 m/s); asked them to hold what they have to the line.
no cue: 189 m left, cue gate closed until inside the last 100 m; the hold cue is already given.
